name: o9k
description: its-over-9k (o9k) — the connector between agent frameworks for Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, OpenCode and Hermes. Arbitrates which tool owns which concern, wires them into every host, and keeps the interplay efficient. Ships no features of its own.

plugins.name: o9k-core
plugins.description: Required. The o9k doctrine: efficiency rules of engagement plus the arbitration layer that keeps every other framework from colliding. Owns host wiring, /o9k-init, /o9k-guide, /o9k-update, /o9k-stats. Install this first — the other pillars are opt-in.

plugins.name: o9k-scout
plugins.description: Optional. Context discipline: load structure before files, search before read, one canonical repo map per session. For people working in real codebases.

plugins.name: o9k-memory
plugins.description: Optional. Persistent memory integration: session-start briefing, on-demand recall, save-before-compact. Prefers TIM (npm tim-cli), falls back to hmem (npm hmem-mcp). For projects spanning many sessions.

plugins.name: o9k-recon
plugins.description: Optional. Discovery & onboarding: framework-scout finds new agent frameworks and classifies them symbiotic/orthogonal/blocking; companion-bundles installs a conflict-free stack in one command. For people who curate their tool stack.
